featuresSection.subtitle: From template creation to cryptographic verification — DocuVault handles every step of the document lifecycle.

features.templatesDesc: Design rich-text templates with merge fields, category tagging, and data source mapping. Generate personalised PDFs in seconds.
features.bulkPdfDesc: Generate hundreds of personalised documents from a connected database in one click. Each PDF is individually signed and hashed.
features.esignDesc: Approvers review and apply a legally meaningful electronic signature that is cryptographically embedded in the document.
features.cryptoDesc: Every document receives a SHA-256 content hash and HMAC stamp at generation time. Any tampering is instantly detected on verification.
features.deliveryDesc: Recipients receive documents via a one-time OTP-protected link. They must verify identity, acknowledge receipt, and then download.
features.forensicDesc: Every action — generation, approval, signature, delivery, download — is logged in an immutable, timestamped audit trail.

howSection.subtitle: A clear, auditable process that keeps everyone accountable at every stage.

steps.createDesc: System Admin designs a reusable template with merge fields and data mappings.
steps.generateDesc: Generator selects a template, fills data, and produces a signed PDF.
steps.requestDesc: The document is routed to an Approver for review.
steps.esignDesc: Approver reviews and applies a cryptographic e-signature.
steps.deliverDesc: Generator delivers the document to the Recipient via OTP-protected link.
steps.verifyDesc: Anyone can verify authenticity and integrity using the Document ID or QR code.

securitySection.subtitle: DocuVault doesn't bolt security on — it's woven into every layer. Every document is hashed, signed, and logged the moment it's created.

chain.hash: SHA-256 hash computed at generation time — any byte-level change is detected instantly.
chain.hmac: HMAC-SHA256 stamp seals the hash with a server secret — prevents forgery even if the hash is known.
chain.otp: One-time OTP delivered to the recipient's email — ensures only the intended person can access the document.
chain.jwt: JWT-authenticated API calls — every action is tied to a verified identity.
chain.audit: Immutable audit trail — every event is logged with a timestamp and cannot be edited or deleted.
